description: Score what an extractor or bill auditor reported about one document against its answer key, rebuilt from the type, scenario and seed with this version of claimseed. The report uses the answer key's vocabulary (schema://extractor-output): `fields` maps field paths of documents[0].fields to the values read; `errors` lists flagged errors as { kind, fieldRef or lineRef }. Returns field accuracy with the paths read wrong or missed, error recall and precision, false alarms, and which decoys were flagged. The result names only answer-key paths, kinds and decoy ids, never the text sent. Nothing is rendered or written.

layout_variant.description: Optional. A layout variant id from this document type's published list, or seeded to pick one from the seed. Applies only to itemized-bill, ppo-eob and hmo-eob. Leave it out for the standard layout, unchanged. The answer key records which variant was used.

output.description: the extractor's report (schema://extractor-output). What an extractor or bill auditor reports about one claimseed document, for scoring with `claimseed-core verify` or the MCP tool verify_document. It uses the answer key's vocabulary: field paths are the keys of documents[0].fields, and an error names its kind (docs/error-taxonomy.md) and its place as a fieldRef (a path in documents[0].fields, or a field inside it) or a lineRef (a path in the claims block). Either part may be left out to score only the other.

errors.description: Billing errors the tool flagged. An error is found when its kind matches and its place names the same line or total as the answer key (for a duplicate charge, either line of the pair).

fields.description: Values read from the document, keyed by answer-key field path. Money may be a number or printed text such as "$1,234.50"; dates may be ISO, M/D/YYYY or "April 11, 2026"; text is compared without regard to case or repeated spaces.

seed.description: any short string (letters, digits, . _ -); the same seed always gives the same document

type.description: document type: msn, itemized-bill, ppo-eob, hmo-eob

name: verify_document
title: Score an extractor against a document
